sections.shortTitle: The Larkana Development Authority Revival and Amending Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE LYARI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
THE LYARI
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(REVIVAL AND AMENDING) ACT, 2013
SINDH
ACT NO. LIV OF 2013
KARACHI,
THE 19th NOVEMBER, 2013
AN
ACT
NO.PAS/Legis-B-15/2013---The
Lyari Development Authority (Revival and Amending)
Bill, 2013 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 19th September, 2013 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 7th November, 2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. to revive and amend the law
relating to the Lyari Development Authority.
Preamble.- WHEREAS in order to give impetus and encourage the
housing industry and provide shelter
to the people of the Province, it is expedient to revive and amend the Lyari
Development Authority Act, 1993, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.--(1) This Act
may be called the Lyari Development Authority
(Revival and Amending), Act, 2013.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.
